name: Phil's Auto and Fleet Repair
founded_note: a locally owned shop serving Lodi drivers and fleets

reviews.quote: I highly recommend Phil's Auto and Fleet Repair. I called on a Saturday morning for an appointment for an alignment on my BMW X3. They took me in right away, completed the work in the said time, gave me a report and my suv drives smoothly.
reviews.name: Tracey P.

reviews.quote: Phil and his shop do the best work! My ford fusion kept having the service advance track light come on randomly. I was leaving for a trip in 4 days and needed it fixed desperately. I called Phil and he worked me into his schedule that day and put more effort in than any other shop I have been to. I was back on the road that same day!
reviews.name: Hannah K.

reviews.quote: Replies back pretty quick and in a reasonable time. Their prices are fair and not too overly expensive like going to some dealership that cost you an arm and a leg. Thank you Phil's Auto and Fleet Repair for your time, quote and services.
reviews.name: Michael D.

reviews.quote: GREAT SERVICE! Above and beyond expectations!! Completed service on schedule!! I will be bringing my cars here from now on!
reviews.name: Verified customer

review_themes: The most common thread in public reviews: vehicles that were misdiagnosed elsewhere getting sorted out here.
Customers repeatedly describe getting an objective service plan instead of a list of add-ons they didn't ask for.
Turnaround that matches what was quoted comes up again and again — the reason fleet customers stay.

area_notes.Lodi: Our home city — downtown, the east side, Kettleman Lane and everywhere between.
area_notes.Stockton: A short run down Highway 99 for drivers who want a shop that isn't a chain.
area_notes.Galt: North of us on 99, and a regular stop for fleet and diesel customers.
area_notes.Acampo: Minutes away, including vineyard and agricultural vehicles.
area_notes.Woodbridge: Just west of Lodi — daily drivers and work trucks alike.
area_notes.Lockeford: East on Highway 12, well worth the drive for a proper diagnosis.
area_notes.Victor: Close by, and familiar territory for our diesel customers.
area_notes.Thornton: Delta-area drivers and farm fleets we've come to know.
area_notes.Clements: Rural miles are hard on vehicles; we service them accordingly.
area_notes.Elk Grove: Further north, but customers make the trip for second opinions.
